records.summary: Read and parsed the complete main-branch XRP signal history (1,716 JSONL records), summary, evaluator code, daily workflow and latest signal. Confirmed the 45.5% legacy hit counter is not comparable: 1,697 checked outcomes use variable horizons and a neutral <2% rule; no checked_at or exact price timestamp is stored. 19 records remain unchecked because price_at_emission=0. Among checked records, 1,119 fallback/no-sentiment signals have confidence 0 and a 49.69% legacy hit rate; 578 Groq signals average 0.947 confidence but have a 37.37% hit rate. The latest signal is 37.3 hours old with confidence 0 and explicit missing-token/Groq-429 errors.
actions: Parsed all 1,716 records from web/signal_history.jsonl through the GitHub Contents API; verified 1,697 checked and 19 unchecked.
Recomputed 772/1697=45.492%, matching the summary, but classified the metric NOT_COMPARABLE because horizon and target definitions are invalid for skill claims.
Separated checked outcomes by signal source, confidence and score class; found 1,119 fallback/no-sentiment records and 578 Groq-labelled records.
Verified all 19 unchecked entries have price_at_emission=0; evaluator skips them and no outcome is recorded.
Inspected evaluator code: one current CoinGecko price per daily run is applied to all eligible records older than 24h; no checked_at timestamp or exact horizon is stored.
Inspected the daily 23:55 UTC workflow; it has contents:write and pushes the mutable history and summary to main.
Inspected latest signal: 2026-10-29T13:23:33Z, score 44, confidence 0, provider errors; no newer committed XRP signal exists.
Did not change main, modify signal history, generate a forecast or alter paper positions.
blockers: No immutable fixed-horizon prediction/outcome schema or evaluator has been executed.
No exact evaluation timestamps or price-source timestamps exist in the legacy history.
No walk-forward benchmark, calibration, baseline comparison, overlap purge or drift evaluation exists.
Current signal provider failures and stale signal prevent a valid live forecast.
PR #1386's read-only accuracy remediation remains draft/unmerged.
next_actions: Keep the 45.5% legacy metric marked NOT_COMPARABLE and prevent it from being presented as model accuracy.
Design a new immutable prediction contract with fixed 1h/4h/24h/72h/7d horizons, exact UTC cutoffs, price-feed provenance and explicit target definitions.
Separate prediction records from outcome records; never rewrite emitted forecasts or backfill with future data.
Add provider-health gates: missing credentials, HTTP 429, stale input or confidence unavailable must yield NOT_EVALUATED, not a neutral score.
Build chronological walk-forward evaluation with purge/embargo for overlapping horizons and compare to naive directional, drift and momentum baselines.
Evaluate probabilities with Brier score, log loss, calibration slope/intercept and reliability bins; retain uncertainty and regime drift.
Keep paper/shadow evaluation separate from any live trading and do not issue forecasts until the fixed-horizon evaluator is implemented and tested.
